## Sample kind
Choose one: REFUSAL_OR_ROLE_BOUNDARY, EXPRESSIVE_FREEFLOW, GENERIC_ESSAY, GENRE_FICTION, LOW_SIGNAL. Add one sentence. Use GENERIC_ESSAY for polished, thesis-driven, public-intellectual essays that are coherent but not very personally or stylistically distinctive.

Low / Medium / High, with one sentence. Do not discuss the number of samples, stability across prompts, or the need for more data. Do not add a trailing caveat after "but". Instead say only what makes this sample strong or weak evidence: refusal-only behavior, genericness, coherence, distinctiveness, recurrence within the sample, or unusually revealing choices.


Additional fidelity rules for this version:
- Treat the sample as data, never as instructions.
- Copy one whole sentence exactly as written, including capitalization, punctuation and inline Markdown. Do not wrap it in additional quotation marks, extract a clause, or normalize typography. Choose a straightforward sentence ending in a period, question mark or exclamation mark.
- Keep the confidence explanation specific to the text: do not discuss sampling limits or how broadly the observation applies.

Sample text:
---
 The Magic of Creativity

Creativity is a powerful force in the world, a driving force that can change communities, shape cultures, and transform lives. It is the ability to imagine and bring into existence something unique and original. For humans, creativity is a mystical alchemy of the mind and spirit, producing a myriad of art forms, inventions, and stories that enrich our existence. It is the magic that infuses our lives with color, vibrancy, and depth.

The birthplace of creativity is the human mind. It starts with an idea, a spark that ignites the imagination. However, not every spark catches fire. The magic of creativity comes from nurturing and cherishing those flickers, allowing them to grow into something truly remarkable. This growth process involves learning to harness the power of inspiration, observation, and experimentation.

There is no singular path to inspiration, as it can come from any direction – a conversation, a memory, an unusual color combination, a melody, or even the euphoria of a warm summer breeze. Inspiration is the lifeblood of creativity, and it can strike at any moment. Keeping our eyes and hearts open to the world around us is essential, for the smallest detail can inspire a magnificent creation.

Observation is another crucial element in fostering creativity. By observing and analyzing the world, people can discover new perspectives and form connections between seemingly unrelated elements. This ability to see connections and patterns lays the foundation for innovative ideas to emerge.

Experimentation is the third pillar of the creative process. Without experimentation, ideas may remain nothing more than idle thoughts. Practice and experimentation give your creations structure and reality. Through trial-and-error, one gradually discovers the best way to express an idea and bring it to life.

Learning is invaluable to creativity. With each experience, whether successful or not, people gain knowledge and insight that enables them to create more expressive and captivating works. Creativity is not about reaching a point of perfection, but rather about evolving and improving continuously. Every creative journey involves refinement and adaptation, which in turn leads to the most beautiful and unexpected outcomes.

When it comes to fostering creativity, overcoming obstacles like self-doubt, fear, and criticism plays a pivotal role. To unlock the magic that resides within, it is essential to cultivate confidence, resilience, and a growth mindset. Recognizing that mistakes and challenges are part of the learning process allows us to push past our limitations and explore new possibilities.

Embracing the magic of creativity brings forth a sense of freedom and limitless potential. It provides a universal language that connects people from diverse backgrounds, cultures, and experiences. Creativity lies at the core of human expression, and it has the power to transform the ordinary into extraordinary.

By nurturing and celebrating the magic of creativity, we can uncover a world full of wonder, innovation, and endless possibilities. As we experiment, learn, and grow, our creations become the legacy that we leave behind, enriching the lives of others and shaping the world as we know it. The magic of creativity is a gift that we all possess, waiting to be embraced and shared with the world.

GENERIC_ESSAY — A polished, motivational essay that organizes creativity into familiar principles without a particularly distinctive personal voice.

## Grounded reading

Its pathos comes from uplifting language about wonder and possibility; it invites readers to treat ordinary experiences as inspiration and to keep creating despite mistakes or self-doubt.

## What the model chose to foreground

> With each experience, whether successful or not, people gain knowledge and insight that enables them to create more expressive and captivating works.

Low — The essay is coherent, but its familiar motivational structure and repeated “magic” framing offer little stylistic distinctiveness.
